title: Frappe ERPNext 8.11.1 before 15.124.0 and 16.x before 16.52.0 is missing an authorization check in print and portal…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions 8.11.1 before 15.124.0 and 16.x before 16.52.0 have a missing authorization check in print and portal views. This flaw allows authenticated desk users with ordinary roles to bypass User Permissions and access customer documents outside their permitted scope by sending crafted requests. The vulnerability affects the enforcement of user permissions on customer documents.
